title: "YOUR OLD SERVANT"
sub: Zhao Tuo, king of Nanyue, wrote to the Han emperor as your old servant, great chief of the barbarians.
say: Jow Twaw, king of Nahn-yweh, wrote to the Han emperor as your old servant, great chief of the barbarians.

title: "ONLY FOR FUN"
sub: He had called himself emperor, he wrote, only to amuse himself.
say: He had called himself emperor, he wrote, only to amuse himself.

title: IRON BAN → WAR
sub: In fact, after Han banned iron sales to Nanyue, he had attacked the border towns of Changsha. A Han army sent south was stopped by heat and disease.
say: In fact, after Han banned iron sales to Nahn-yweh, he had attacked the border towns of Chahng-shah. A Han army sent south was stopped by heat and disease.

title: EMPEROR AT HOME
sub: But Sima Qian adds a quiet line. Inside his own kingdom, Zhao Tuo kept the old title. A king to Han. An emperor at home.
say: But Suh-mah Chyen adds a quiet line. Inside his own kingdom, Jow Twaw kept the old title. A king to Han. An emperor at home.

title: THE SEAL
sub: Decades later, his grandson was buried with a seal that said exactly that. Emperor.
say: Decades later, his grandson was buried with a seal that said exactly that. Emperor.

title: HOW LONG?
sub: How long could a kingdom play both roles?
say: How long could a kingdom play both roles?
